What this changes and why:

- [ ] `./gradlew :core:test :app:lintDebug :wear:lintDebug` passes (from `android/`)
- [ ] Timing, protocol or `.fit` changes: say what you measured and on which camera and firmware
- [ ] Android Gradle Plugin version changed: `verification-metadata.xml` has the `aapt2` jars for linux, osx and windows (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No DJI SDK, demo or documentation material, and no personal data (GPS tracks, device addresses)
